The same MapServer also exposes separate thematic layers for Land Value (10), Building Value (12), Assessed Value (14), Property Class Code (16) if per-theme geometry is preferred.

zoning.notes: 'BOCC Zoning' layer on Pasco County Property Appraiser's Land_Use MapServer. ZN_TYPE/ZN_STR fields also present. Companion layer 0 = 'BOCC Future Land Use'.

future_land_use.notes: 'BOCC Future Land Use' layer, companion to BOCC Zoning (layer 1) in the same MapServer.

parcels.notes: 'Parcel_JOIN' hosted Feature Service - copyrightText confirms 'DATA STEWARD AND EDITOR: Pinellas County Property Appraiser (727) 464-3207 www.pcpao.org'. serviceDescription: 'Derived from the Pinellas PAO's parcel data set for PCEM purposes. STATIC, updated semi-monthly.' Rich attribute set (105 fields) including owner, sales, flood, and value info.

zoning.note: 'Zoning (Unincorporated)' dataset found on Pinellas County Enterprise GIS open data hub (https://new-pinellas-egis.opendata.arcgis.com/datasets/Pinellas-eGIS::zoning-unincorporated/about, item id 6788fdb8ac104cb18e1600fd7cf194f8) but the underlying hosted FeatureServer URL could not be resolved - the AGOL sharing/rest content-item endpoint for this org returns a 403 'Token Required'/permission error even for this public dataset, and the Hub site is a JS-rendered SPA with no static REST link in page source. Also see the county's live 'Zoning/Land Use Unincorporated Lookup' app at https://egis.pinellas.gov/apps/egis/apps.html and Forward Pinellas Countywide Plan Map at https://forwardpinellas.org/document-portal/countywide-plan-map-gis/ for the county-wide future land use equivalent.

parcels.notes: Polk County BoCC public GIS, All-In-One_Viewer/Property_Appraiser 'Parcels' layer (438,562 parcels, Property Appraiser CAMA attributes: DOR use code, land/building/total values, assessed/taxable, acreage, site address/city). Replaces the POLK_PARCEL_BOUNDARIES_MIL1 layer, which only exposes a 3,494-feature subset. Owner name and mailing address fields are excluded on ingest.

zoning.note: No standalone county-wide 'Zoning' REST layer found on gis.polk-county.net despite checking the Planning, PublicViewer, and All-In-One_Viewer folders' 'Map_Land_Use_and_Zoning'/'Land_Use_and_Zoning' MapServers (layers found: Special Protection Areas, DRIs, SPDs, PDs, PUDs, Selected Area Plans, Overlay Wetlands, Green Swamp, Development Areas, Future Land Use 2030 - no base 'Zoning' layer). Polk County's Future Land Use 2030 layer (e.g. https://gis.polk-county.net/hosting/rest/services/PublicViewer/Map_Land_Use_and_Zoning/MapServer/9) is the closest queryable equivalent. For parcel-level zoning lookups see the Property Appraiser's interactive map at https://map.polkflpa.gov/ or the county's public data portal https://polk-county-geoportal-open-data-polk-bocc-gis.hub.arcgis.com/.

future_land_use.notes: Polk County 'Future Land Use 2030' (PublicViewer/Map_Land_Use_and_Zoning layer 9, 5,414 polygons). County has no standalone zoning REST layer; FLU is the closest county-wide equivalent.

parcels.notes: Putnam County GIS 'Parcels' layer (CadastralData service) combining cadastral + CAMA data. No distinct building-value field (LNDVALUE is land value only; CNTASSDVAL is current total assessed value). No numeric acreage field (STATEDAREA is a text description, not a number). No zoning field on this layer.

zoning.note: No public REST/ArcGIS service found for Putnam County zoning. County's own GIS server (https://pamap.putnam-fl.gov/server/rest/services) exposes only Aerials2023, CadastralData, CamaSales, FieldAppraiser, Labels, ReferencePoints - no Zoning service/folder as of Sept 2026. Putnam publishes zoning as a static map/PDF instead: https://www.putnam-fl.gov/departments/development-services/planning-and-zoning/zoning/ and quarterly zoning-map PDFs on the Putnam Data Hub, e.g. https://putnam-pcgis.hub.arcgis.com/documents/08855a60328c42b988c0804bd90e126c

parcels.notes: Santa Rosa County GIS open-data parcels layer ('ParcelsOpenData', built from the Property Appraiser's parcel dataset). No land/building/total value fields present in this public layer.

zoning.notes: Unincorporated-county zoning districts ('Zone_NoCity...' layer, excludes municipal zoning). Same data is also hosted at https://services.arcgis.com/Eg4L1xEv2R3abuQd/ArcGIS/rest/services/Zoning/FeatureServer/0.

future_land_use.notes: Santa Rosa County Future Land Use layer (unincorporated county).

parcels.notes: 'ParcelHosted' - Sarasota County Enterprise GIS hosted Feature Service. Service description: 'Sarasota County Parcels with appended ownership and site addresses, property valuations and tax info, and land-use and zoning information.' No explicit land-value or land-use-code field was identified in the field list (ASSD/TXBL/JUST are the value fields; land-use code not clearly separated from ZONING) - verify against a sample record before relying on land_value/land_use_code.

zoning.notes: 'CountyZoning' hosted Feature Service on Sarasota County's ags3.scgov.net ArcGIS Server (found via item lookup, item id c8d0d385abfd42fb8a5e885be928374a). Also has zoninggroup, ordinancenumber, municipality fields.

parcels.note: No public ArcGIS REST endpoint found after several probes (gis.seminolecountyfl.gov and egis.seminolecountyfl.gov do not resolve; no county ArcGIS Hub/opendata.arcgis.com site with a hosted parcels service was located). Seminole County publishes parcel data only as downloadable Esri file-geodatabase/shapefile bundles via https://www.seminolecountyfl.gov/departments-services/information-technology/gis-geographic-information-systems/gis-data-shapefiles (includes Parcels + ParcelTable1). The Seminole County Property Appraiser's interactive map at https://map.scpafl.org/ (Public Appraisal Map v5.4.1) is a parcel viewer with no discoverable public API.

zoning.note: Zoning is included in the same bulk GIS data-shapefiles download listed above (https://www.seminolecountyfl.gov/departments-services/information-technology/gis-geographic-information-systems/gis-data-shapefiles), which lists a 'Zoning' layer alongside Parcels/Streets/Addresses. No REST/FeatureServer endpoint was found.

parcels.notes: St. Johns County GIS Division 'Parcel' MapServer (portal_sjcgis). Uses the same regional CAMA/GIS export schema as Volusia (PC/PC_DESC, CALCACRES, LANDACRES, and taxable-value fields STXBL/NSTXBL/COTXBL/CITXBL) - no separate land/building/total market value fields available. Also carries PIN/PID/PARID identifiers.

zoning.notes: Zoning classifications for unincorporated St. Johns County, maintained by St. Johns County GIS Division / Growth Management. No stored description field - zone descriptions live only in the map renderer's legend.

future_land_use.notes: Future Land Use boundaries for St. Johns County.

parcels.note: No public parcel-boundary REST/FeatureServer layer found. St. Lucie County's ArcGIS Hub (data-slc.opendata.arcgis.com, DCAT feed checked) lists ~40 datasets (Roads, Zoning, Future Land Use, Flood Zones, etc.) but no Parcels layer. Parcel/CAMA maps are served through the Property Appraiser's own system at https://saintluciecountypropertyappraiser.org/gis-maps/ and https://map.paslc.gov/search/ (Schneider/BHA 'StLucie_PAT' tax-map application), which is a search-based viewer, not an open queryable parcel REST service.

zoning.notes: St. Lucie County GIS Division hosted Zoning layer (ArcGIS Hub dataset 'Zoning', slcgis.stlucieco.gov). Found via the county's DCAT open-data feed.

future_land_use.notes: St. Lucie County GIS Division hosted Future Land Use layer. Query output uses lowercase field names (flucode, area_ac) unlike the layer metadata.

parcels.notes: SWFWMD-hosted mirror ('Sumter County Parcels' layer) of Sumter County Property Appraiser cadastral data, DOR-derived schema. Sumter County's own ArcGIS Online org also hosts a 'Parcels_gdb' layer (https://services8.arcgis.com/FTrtUCmxaVKdPC5e/ArcGIS/rest/services/Parcels_gdb/FeatureServer/0, key field PIN) with richer land-use fields (DOR_LUC, PropUseCod/Des, Acres_Lot_) but no assessed-value fields - use in combination if needed.

zoning.notes: 'Zoning' layer (countywide/unincorporated), layer 11 of Sumter County's official Interactive/FLU_Zoning service. Field semantics of ZONING_C_1/ZONING_C_2 vs Zone_Type could not be fully confirmed from metadata alone - spot-check sample records before production use. Municipal zoning is split into separate layers 6-10 (Bushnell/Center Hill/Coleman/Webster/Wildwood) of the same service.

future_land_use.notes: 'Unincorporated Future Land Use' layer, same service as zoning above.

parcels.notes: Suwannee County's own official hosted parcels layer (2024 vintage, owner account countyofsuwannee), DOR-derived schema shared with the Levy/Sumter SWFWMD mirrors. Zoning is embedded in this same layer (ZONING field) - no separate/dedicated zoning REST service was found for Suwannee County. The Property Appraiser's public site (suwannee.floridapa.com/GIS/, suwanneepa.com/GIS_Support/) offers only an interactive map viewer with no exposed API.

parcels.note: No public ArcGIS REST/API layer found for Taylor County. Parcel search via qPublic: https://qpublic.net/fl/taylor/ (Taylor County Property Appraiser's own qPublic portal, confirmed via search).

zoning.note: Taylor County Planning & Zoning maps page fetched and confirmed working: https://www.taylorcountygov.com/departments/planning_and_zoning/maps.php - offers only static PDF map downloads (flood, evacuation routes, wetlands, etc.), no interactive GIS/REST service exposed.

parcels.note: No public ArcGIS REST/API layer found for Union County, FL (do not confuse with an ArcGIS-hosted 'UnionParcels02102026' / 'ZoningDistrict' service under org oX0kbxItOpLtURFa owned by lsmith_unioncounty - verified via spatial reference/extent (NJ State Plane, WKID 2271) and field names that this is Union County, NEW JERSEY, not Florida - excluded). Union County Property Appraiser GIS/advanced search page found via search: https://union.floridapa.com/gis/ (main site https://union.floridapa.com/).

zoning.note: No public REST/API zoning layer found for Union County, FL in a focused search. No dedicated county zoning GIS portal located.

parcels.notes: 'Parcels' layer (id 0) inside the Countywide Zoning service, published by Volusia County GIS. Also carries LANDACRES/LANDSQFT and taxable-value fields (STXBL/NSTXBL/COTXBL/CITXBL) but no separate land/building/total market value fields, so those were left out of field_map rather than guessed.

zoning.notes: 'Countywide Zoning' layer - crosswalks each jurisdiction's own zoning code (JUR_ZONING, JurisdictionCode) to a generalized GenericZoningCode/GenericDescription. Includes City/unincorporated zoning countywide.

parcels.notes: Official Wakulla County parcels layer ('a layer of parcels in wakulla county'), hosted on county ArcGIS Online org (owner brandon.geiger), no auth required, ~18MB, editable/sync-enabled service. Layer is geometry-focused: only OBJECTID, MAP_ACRES, PARCEL_ID, GlobalID plus shape fields - no land use, zoning, or valuation attributes on this layer itself.

zoning.notes: Official Wakulla County zoning layer ('Zoning_Master Pro'), same ArcGIS Online org as the parcels layer (owner acheek, county GIS staff). Service description: 'official zoning information for property located in Wakulla County' per the county Land Development Code.

parcels.notes: Walton County official 'EnerGov Rest Service - Walton County GIS Data made for EnerGov application also general use for Walton County GIS data needs - Updated Weekly' (owner laikevin, county GIS org). This 54-layer service also includes Zoning (19) and Future Land Use (15). Also considered a separate 'WaltonCountyPropeties' service (same org, Walton_County_Parcels layer) with richer valuation fields (JUST_VALUE, APPRAISED_VALUE, AG_LAND, etc. as strings) but only updated as of 2026-05-16 vs this weekly-updated EnerGov service - preferred EnerGov as primary source.

zoning.notes: Walton County official Zoning layer within the same weekly-updated EnerGov GIS service. Also carries PLAN_AREA, Ordinance_Number/Date, Previous_Zoning fields for provenance.

future_land_use.notes: Walton County official Future Land Use layer within the same EnerGov GIS service. Historical FLU snapshots also available as layers 16 (1996-2010) and 17 (2011-2018).

parcels.notes: Washington County parcel layer in standard FL DOR NAL (statewide parcel tax roll) field layout, current as of Aug 2024, hosted by GIS consultant matthew.gore9 (also publishes other FDOT/local GIS work). Extent (FIPS 3086, bbox ~208664-263039 / 710668-759038) confirms this is scoped to Washington County only, not statewide, despite generic service description text. No dedicated acreage field (only LND_SQFOOT in square feet); no separate building/improvement value field in the standard DOR layout (JV includes land+improvements).

zoning.note: No public REST/API zoning layer found for Washington County. County Planning Department page (fetched, confirmed working): https://www.washingtonfl.com/departments/planning/about/ - links an interactive GIS/zoning map maintained by the Emerald Coast Regional Council (formerly West Florida Regional Planning Council), but no exposed zoning FeatureServer/MapServer endpoint was found (only the Future Land Use layer below is exposed as a REST service).

future_land_use.notes: Washington County Future Land Use layer, published by West Florida Regional Planning Council (org owner jmp507), embedded in the county's official 'Washington County Future Land Use Map' web map (25.7k views, last updated 2025-05-09). Includes historical/municipal companion layers (e.g. Wausau FLUM) not captured here.
